tools.name: create_learner
tools.title: Create learner
tools.description: Enroll one person in a course: takes one seat and sends the invite email. If the email or externalId already names an active learner, returns that learner and takes no seat, so repeating is safe. Fails with seat_unavailable when no seat is free (check get_seat_inventory). Requires scope learners:write.

name.description: Full name, as printed on the certificate.

externalId.description: Your system's id for this person (unique per organization).

courseId.description: Course id. Defaults to the organization's default course.

delivery.description: email (default): we send the invite. none: no email; the result carries a single-use joinUrl you must hand to the learner.

tools.name: create_learner_launch_link
tools.title: Create learner launch link
tools.description: Mint a single-use sign-in URL into the training app for one learner, valid five minutes. It is a bearer link: give it only to that learner. Refused for admins, removed learners and learners who have not accepted their invite yet. Requires scope learners:write.

learnerId.description: The learner's id (sub_…), as returned by list_learners.

courseId.description: Course id. Defaults to the organization's default course.

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.title: Get certificate
tools.description: Get one certificate record of the organization by id. Requires scope certificates:read.

tools.name: get_compliance_summary
tools.title: Get compliance summary
tools.description: Organization-wide training compliance for one course: how many learners are compliant, expiring soon, expired, in progress, not started or bounced, and the compliant rate. For the people behind a number, call list_learners with the matching status. Requires scope compliance:read.

courseId.description: Course id. Defaults to the organization's default course.

tools.name: get_learner
tools.title: Get learner
tools.description: Get one learner's training state in one course: status, invite/start/completion dates and current certificate. Requires scope learners:read.

learnerId.description: The learner's id (sub_…), as returned by list_learners.

courseId.description: Course id. Defaults to the organization's default course.

tools.name: get_seat_inventory
tools.title: Get seat inventory
tools.description: How many seats the organization holds and how many are free to enroll new learners. Each create_learner takes one seat. Requires scope enrollments:read.

tools.name: list_audit_events
tools.title: List audit events
tools.description: Read the organization's audit trail, newest first: who changed what (enrollment transitions, member and learner changes, certificates, seats, API clients). A short page with a cursor means keep paging. Requires scope audit:read.

type.description: Only audit events of this family.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, to read the next one.

tools.name: list_certificates
tools.title: List certificates
tools.description: List the organization's certificate records (VALID, EXPIRED or REVOKED), every course and cycle. Pass learnerId for one person's full history. Paginated with cursor. Requires scope certificates:read.

learnerId.description: Only this learner's certificates (all of them, unpaged).

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, to read the next one.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List the public TeachMeHIPAA course catalog (course ids, titles, passing score). Use a courseId from here in learner and compliance tools.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, to read the next one.

tools.name: list_learners
tools.title: List learners
tools.description: List the organization's learners for one course with their training status (not_started, invite_bounced, in_progress, compliant, expiring_soon, expired, removed) and current certificate. Filter by status, or look one person up by email or externalId. Paginated: pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Requires scope learners:read.

email.description: Find the one learner with this email.

externalId.description: Find the one learner with this external (HRIS) id.

courseId.description: Course id. Defaults to the organization's default course.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, to read the next one.

tools.name: list_org_events
tools.title: List organization events
tools.description: Read the organization's event log (the same events webhooks deliver, kept 30 days), oldest first: learner invited/started/certified/expiring/expired/removed, seats. Resume with after = the last eventId seen. Requires scope webhooks:manage or audit:read.

after.description: The last eventId already seen (a page's nextCursor).

tools.name: offboard_learner
tools.title: Offboard learner
tools.description: Remove a person from the organization's training. A learner who never started has the invite cancelled and the seat returned; one who started loses their membership (history is kept). Admins cannot be offboarded. Repeating on a removed learner is a no-op. Requires scope learners:write.

learnerId.description: The learner's id (sub_…), as returned by list_learners.

courseId.description: Course id. Defaults to the organization's default course.

tools.name: remind_learner
tools.title: Remind learner
tools.description: Email a learner a reminder to finish their training. Each call sends another email. Requires scope learners:write.

learnerId.description: The learner's id (sub_…), as returned by list_learners.

courseId.description: Course id. Defaults to the organization's default course.

tools.name: update_learner
tools.title: Update learner
tools.description: Change a learner's name or externalId (externalId null clears it). The name is what the certificate prints. Admins and people in more than one organization cannot be renamed through the API. Requires scope learners:write.

learnerId.description: The learner's id (sub_…), as returned by list_learners.

courseId.description: Course id. Defaults to the organization's default course.

externalId.description: New external id, or null to clear it.

tools.name: verify_certificate
tools.title: Verify certificate
tools.description: Check a certificate behind a tme.so verification link, as anyone holding the link can: valid, expired or revoked, with the name and course printed on it. Works for any organization's certificate.

tinyId.description: The id at the end of a tme.so verification link, e.g. cAbC123xYz789 for https://tme.so/cAbC123xYz789.

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Show which TeachMeHIPAA organization and API client this server is connected as, the scopes the client was granted, and when the current access token expires. Call this first when a tool answers 403.
